title: MOBA VFX (Playable WIP)
description: A real-time Unity WebGL showcase featuring stylized MOBA-inspired VFX, including elemental abilities, spell impacts, energy trails, and combat effects crafted for immersive gameplay visuals.

title: Snakes And Ladder (Playable WIP)
description: A cozy and visually polished 3D Snakes & Ladders experience built in Unity WebGL. Roll the dice, climb ladders, avoid sneaky snakes, and race to the finish in a relaxing tabletop-inspired world with smooth animations, warm lighting, and casual mobile-game aesthetics.

title: Parametric Lightning Shader
description: A highly optimized, real-time lightning shader built in Unity that generates endless variations from a single material. Featured on Jettelly, it utilizes Vertex Streams, flipbook distortion, and custom posterization to deliver snappy, realistic strikes with HDR edge bloom.

title: Cake Idle Game
description: A casual mobile idle game featuring automated progression mechanics, engaging visual feedback, and optimized assets
